## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?  
CAUTION. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: extremely weak sector breadth (only Healthcare and Technology positive) and major divergence across large caps (multiple banking and comms names BELOW TREND while select Tech/Health/ Energy names are ABOVE TREND), so reduce conviction and monitor for trend breaks.

2. Which sectors are leading?  
Healthcare leads: TMO (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +6.26%) ABOVE TREND, DHR (1W: +5.83% | 1M: +0.15%) ABOVE TREND. Technology next: AMD (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +20.02%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +9.96% | 1M: +1.06%) ABOVE TREND. Energy shows pockets of strength: MPC (1W: +7.31% | 1M: +17.78%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +5.86% | 1M: +19.36%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?  
Communication lagging: NFLX (1W: -7.25% | 1M: -10.51%) BELOW TREND, TMUS (1W: -7.76% | 1M: -7.24%) BELOW TREND, CHTR (1W: -12.07% | 1M: -15.94%) BELOW TREND. Utilities weak: CEG (1W: -10.55% | 1M: -7.10%) BELOW TREND. Financials under pressure: BAC (1W: -7.91% | 1M: -8.15%) BELOW TREND, GS (1W: -8.47% | 1M: -7.34%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?  
Top 5: PANW (1W: +9.96% | 1M: +1.06%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +20.02%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +7.31% | 1M: +17.78%) ABOVE TREND, TMO (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +6.26%) ABOVE TREND, ISRG (1W: +6.55% | 1M: -1.10%) RECOVERY — Leadership: Moderate concentration (Top 5 span Technology, Energy, Healthcare).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?  
Bottom 5: BA (1W: -5.82% | 1M: -10.80%) BELOW TREND, CVS (1W: -6.15% | 1M: -5.14%) BELOW TREND, NFLX (1W: -7.25% | 1M: -10.51%) BELOW TREND, TMUS (1W: -7.76% | 1M: -7.24%) BELOW TREND, BAC (1W: -7.91% | 1M: -8.15%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Communication and Financials.

6. Momentum Stocks?  
Top 1W momentum: PANW (1W: +9.96%), AMD (1W: +8.46%), MPC (1W: +7.31%), TMO (1W: +6.91%), ISRG (1W: +6.55%) RECOVERY; note MAJOR DIVERGENCE — several large caps (MSFT, V, TSLA) show 1W vs 1M sign flips, implying tactical moves not broad confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?  
Mixed but relatively constructive with many leaders ABOVE TREND: AMD (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +20.02%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +1.82% | 1M: +2.28%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: -0.37% | 1M: +2.15%) CORRECTION; Sector breadth estimate: Tech: 14/24 positive — Internal Rotation.

8. Financials Outlook?  
Weak and dispersed: BAC (1W: -7.91% | 1M: -8.15%) BELOW TREND, GS (1W: -8.47% | 1M: -7.34%) BELOW TREND, JPM (1W: -1.84% | 1M: -2.12%) BELOW TREND; Sector breadth estimate: Financials: 4/20 positive — Sector Weakness.

9. Healthcare Outlook?  
Relatively defensive leadership within a mixed tape: TMO (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +6.26%) ABOVE TREND, DHR (1W: +5.83% | 1M: +0.15%) ABOVE TREND, ISRG (1W: +6.55% | 1M: -1.10%) RECOVERY; Sector breadth estimate: Healthcare: 11/17 positive — Internal Rotation.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?  
Favor selective exposure to names showing confirmed ABOVE TREND strength (AMD, TMO, MPC) and reduce exposure to crowded weak areas in Communication and Financials (NFLX, BAC, GS); style: mixed / no clear leadership given weak breadth and major divergences.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: AMD (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +20.02%) ABOVE TREND, ISRG (1W: +6.55% | 1M: -1.10%) RECOVERY.  
BEARISH: BAC (1W: -7.91% | 1M: -8.15%) BELOW TREND, NFLX (1W: -7.25% | 1M: -10.51%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: Healthcare (Sector breadth est. 11/17 positive) — watch TMO/ISRG for follow-through.  
BEARISH: Communication (Sector breadth est. 1/10 positive) — monitor NFLX, TMUS for further weakness.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?  
AMD near short-term continuation zone if stays ABOVE TREND; ISRG RECOVERY needs 1M confirmation to sustain gains; BAC/G S weekly breakdowns would deepen Financials weakness; monitor MPC/VLO for energy unwind or continuation.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?  
MDT (+80): FDA clearance for Hugo surgery push — price showing strength (monitor relative performance).  
ISRG (+75): EU expansion for da Vinci SP — stock in RECOVERY (1W: +6.55% | 1M: -1.10%) — sentiment confirming short-term bounce.  
MPC (+60): Earnings/upgrade-led surge — MPC ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.31% | 1M: +17.78%) confirming accumulation.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?  
CVS (-80): $949m fraud verdict headline — CVS BELOW TREND (1W: -6.15% | 1M: -5.14%) confirming downside.  
BAC (-75): Bond-loss headlines — BAC BELOW TREND (1W: -7.91% | 1M: -8.15%) confirming distribution.  
NFLX (-50): Analyst downgrade — NFLX BELOW TREND (1W: -7.25% | 1M: -10.51%) confirming weakness.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION, style mixed / no clear leadership.  
AMD (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +20.02%) ABOVE TREND, TMO (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +6.26%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +9.96% | 1M: +1.06%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength.  
Key risk: very thin breadth (2/11 sectors positive) and major divergence among large caps (banks and comms BELOW TREND vs pockets of Tech/Health/Energy strength) — watch for trend breaks and sentiment-driven reversals.
